dsh-free-vision 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。免费视觉插件：纯文本模型看图 / OCR / UI / 报错分析，优先免费模型（千问 Qwen3-VL-Flash、豆包、DeepSeek-OCR），设置界面可配置。

posts.en:
dsh-free-vision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2b522c9e83aa7a49b620.html
